SPINSTERS is a fashion show and performance piece celebrating the slow-paced art of crochet. 

Thank you to everyone who took part and made our concept come to reality 🥰 I had so much fun making these outfits and working with @toidinator to make our crochet dream world 🏰

Arm and leg warmers by me

🕸️ 𝕾𝖕𝖎𝖓𝖘𝖙𝖊𝖗𝖘 🕸️

Toi and Adele invite you to partake in the conception of their woven world, revelling in the slow-paced art of crochet. Inspired by the spirit of traditional forms and practices in a modern context, we are resisting the loss of knowledge and power through independent making and self-sufficiency. We are dismantling the misogyny ingrained in the word spinster, defined in the Cambridge dictionary as, “a woman who is not married, especially a woman who is no longer young and seems unlikely ever to marry”. In the Middle Ages, the word spinster was a compliment, a woman who could spin well was economically independent. Our performance is reframing the word spinster as a positive celebration of nurture, wisdom, independence, and power.

Along with the characters of our folklore, we will ravel you into our web and call you to summon your own powers to spin reality into being.
